summary_md: **Gumbii.Digital ([@GumbiiDigital](https://x.com/GumbiiDigital/status/2115064579747168293))** posts an update from the community optimization challenge run by @yukonresearch: **Nemotron 3.5 Lightning** now runs about 169% faster on a single DGX Spark and 128% faster on Apple Silicon, tracked on the CUDA.fast and MLX.fast leaderboards. The attached leaderboard shows decode going from 75.3 to 233.2 tok/s on Spark.

referenced_urls.title: cuda.fast — Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, faster with speculative decode
mlx.fast — Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, faster with speculative decode

relevance: Crowd-sourced kernel/serving speedups for a reasoning model on DGX Spark, with public leaderboards to follow.

media.description: CUDA.fast leaderboard page: 'Nemotron 3.5 Lightning runs 169.4% faster on DGX Spark', decode 75.3 to 233.2 tok/s and prefill 6300.7 tok/s, with a step chart of cuda.fast (169.4%) vs mlx.fast (128.4%) speedups over time.
